user.title: Connect EKF appliances
user.description: Create controls for the Haier air conditioner and Toshiba projector using an existing EKF remote. Optionally select a Samsung TV.

data.tv_music_assistant_entity_id: Music Assistant player for this Chromecast

data_description.projector_on_script: Leave empty to use the existing Projector turn on script.
data_description.projector_off_script: Leave empty to use the existing Projector turn off script.
data_description.projector_power_entity_id: Select a sensor that measures the projector state, such as its HDMI connection.
data_description.tv_entity_id: Select a TV from the Samsung Smart TV integration. Leave empty if you do not want to add TV controls.
data_description.tv_cast_entity_id: Optional. Playback status and controls for cast sessions.
data_description.tv_androidtv_entity_id: Optional. Controls for Android apps that do not expose Cast playback.
data_description.tv_music_assistant_entity_id: Optional. Select the same physical Chromecast in Music Assistant. Its queue controls are used only while Music Assistant owns the Cast session.
data_description.tv_kodi_entity_id: Optional. Kodi controls when the television source is pc or kodi. Selecting the separate projector does not change television playback controls.
data_description.tv_source_entity_id: Optional. Existing text helper with chromecast, pc, projector, kodi, or tv. Leave empty to use Chromecast.
data_description.tv_network_protocol: Normally keep the current protocol. WebSocket 8001 verifies the powered-on TV and authorized connection without sending keys, then updates the existing Samsung integration.
